page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.t1.small is an entry-level virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features a single dedicated x86_64 vCPU and 1.0 GB of system memory. The instance does not include local NVMe or SSD storage, requiring network-attached storage for boot volumes and data. There are no integrated GPUs or complimentary public IPv4 addresses bundled with this instance type.

The underlying x86_64 processor lacks support for advanced instruction sets, including Advanced Vector Extensions (AVX, AVX512), Cryptographic acceleration (AES, SHA_NI), and vector or matrix multiplication extensions (AMX). This absence of hardware-level acceleration limits its performance in cryptographic, mathematical, and vector-heavy operations. Benchmark data is not available, reflecting its positioning as a minimal resource allocation tier.

Given its minimal hardware footprint of 1 vCPU and 1.0 GB of RAM, the ecs.t1.small is designed for high resource density and qualitative cost efficiency in non-demanding environments. It is suited for lightweight utility workloads, simple scripting, basic automation tasks, or low-traffic development and testing environments that do not require high-performance computing or specialized instruction sets.
